verdict.rationale: Angular is an open-source web framework that developers install and run locally; per the evidence, it builds code into a local dist/ directory and does not host or hold user data. 'Export all of my data and leave' is therefore a category error for this kind of product, since there is no vendor-held data store to export from. Nothing in the evidence shows Angular shipping a data-custody or account-export capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
